# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are provided for the latest version available on the default branch (main).

| Version | Supported |
| :------: | :-------: |
| Latest   | YES |
| Older versions | NO |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, **please do not open a public GitHub Issue**, as this could expose users before a fix is available.

Instead, please report the vulnerability by contacting the project maintainer through GitHub using an appropriate private communication channel.

When reporting a vulnerability, please include as much information as possible:

- A description of the issue.
- Steps to reproduce the vulnerability.
- The affected version (if known).
- The potential impact.
- Any proof of concept (if applicable).

Reports will be reviewed as quickly as possible. If the vulnerability is confirmed, reasonable efforts will be made to:

1. Assess the impact.
2. Develop and test a fix.
3. Release a patched version.
4. Publicly disclose the vulnerability after a fix is available, when appropriate.

---

## Security Best Practices

When contributing to the project, please:

- Keep dependencies up to date.
- Avoid introducing unnecessary third-party dependencies.
- Follow secure coding practices.
- Report potential security concerns responsibly.

Thank you for helping keep the project and its users secure.
